# Sebastián Mora Carmona

> Lead Generative AI Engineer crafting agentic systems for the real world. Multi-agent, RAG, MCP, and the unglamorous engineering that keeps it all running.

## About

Personal portfolio for Sebastián Mora Carmona — Lead Generative AI Engineer at Perficient. 5+ years shipping production AI and full-stack systems. Based in Pereira, Colombia. Speaker at TribuAI, Pereira Tech Talks, and AI Tinkerers Pereira on RAG, fine-tuning, and agent design.
